articles.title: Israel marks three years since Hamas's October 7 attack
articles.description: Israel marks the third anniversary of Hamas's October 7, 2023 attack on Wednesday, just weeks before an election in which the deadliest day in the country's history will be front and centre. Memorial events are planned throughout the day to pay tribute to the scores of people killed by militants led by the Islamist movement during their assault from Gaza. For more, FRANCE 24's Stuart Norval is joined by journalist Uri Schneider, reporting from Jerusalem.

related.title: Israel marks third anniversary of October 7 attack as election looms
related.description: Israel will mark the third anniversary of the October 7, 2023 Hamas attack on Wednesday with memorial events across the country, as heightened security surrounds the commemorations and voters prepare for an election in which the deadliest day in Israel’s history is expected to remain a central issue.
related.normalizedTitle: israel marks third anniversary of october 7 attack as election looms

articles.title: Trump to speak to Putin on plague as US, UN urge transparency
articles.description: US President Donald Trump said Tuesday he would speak very soon with Russian President Vladimir Putin over the reported plague death of a laboratory technician, as Washington and the United Nations called for transparency from Moscow. Russian authorities denied that they were imposing anti-plague measures and played down the reports of an incident at a plague research institute in Siberia's Irkutsk region last week.

related.title: Trump says will speak with Putin over Russia's reported plague death
related.description: US President Donald Trump said Tuesday he would speak “very soon” with Russian President Vladimir Putin over the reported death from plague of a laboratory technician, as Washington and the World Health Organization pressed Moscow for greater transparency and clarity over conflicting accounts of the incident in Siberia.
related.normalizedTitle: trump says will speak with putin over russia s reported plague death

articles.description: France has suspended the use of stun grenades by police at student-led demonstrations, the interior minister said Wednesday, as allegations of police brutality mounted after days of sometimes violent demonstrations across the country. Tens of thousands of people took to the streets across France on Tuesday demanding better conditions in high schools. articles.title: Politkovskaya 'predicted' Russia's turn under Putin, editor says on 20th anniversary of her death
articles.description: Assassinated Russian journalist Anna Politkovskaya "predicted" Moscow's trajectory under President Vladimir Putin 20 years ago, her former editor said ahead of the anniversary of her death on Wednesday. Politkovskaya had reported on the war in Chechnya and Putin's rise before she was gunned down in her Moscow apartment block on October 7, 2006.

articles.title: Russia launches one of its biggest strikes on Ukraine, killing at least 21 civilians
articles.description: Russian missiles and drones killed at least 21 people in Ukraine, including four children, in what President Volodymyr Zelensky ‌called a “massive” strike on Wednesday. Ukraine has come under increased attack in recent weeks as Russian attacks have targeted energy infrastructure and rail and road transport.

articles.title: How Netanyahu survived the political fallout from the October 7 attacks
articles.description: Three years after the deadly Hamas-led October 7 attacks in southern Israel, Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu is fighting for political survival ahead of legislative elections later this month. Reports that Arab leaders warned him of the assault in advance have undercut his claims that Israel's security chiefs are to blame, but his political base appears to be holding.

articles.description: Alors qu'elle a accouché d'un petit Dakota il y a sept mois, Clarisse Agbégnénou en lice pour remporter son septième titre mondial, a été sortie par la Hongroise Anna Kriza en quarts de finale, et n'a pas réussi à s'imposer en repêchages.

articles.title: "Soudainement, tu te figes" : trois ans après le 7-Octobre, Omer Shem Tov, ancien otage du Hamas, reste hanté par sa captivité
articles.description: Libéré après 505 jours de captivité à Gaza, Omer Shem Tov tente de reconstruire sa vie, mais les souvenirs de sa détention refont surface régulièrement. Trois ans après le 7-Octobre, l’ancien otage raconte son traumatisme et son espoir de ne plus être un jour seulement considéré comme "Omer Shem Tov, l’ancien otage".

articles.title: En Israël, trois ans après le 7-Octobre, les traumatismes et les aveuglements d’un pays

Depuis le drame, le pays poursuit une guerre sans fin motivée par un désir de vengeance, sans s’interroger sur les failles qui ont conduit au désastre.

articles.description: Le pouvoir d’achat des ménages pourrait se détériorer de manière durable en raison de la situation internationale. C’est ce qu’écrit le Fonds monétaire international dans son dernier rapport. Le FMI met en avant la poussée de l’inflation partout dans le monde.

articles.title: Haiti postpones elections indefinitely amid gang violence
articles.description: Haiti has indefinitely postponed elections scheduled for December and February, the electoral council said Tuesday, citing technical and operational requirements as gang violence continues to disrupt preparations. The delay leaves Haitians without a democratic process as authorities struggle to register voters and secure areas needed for the poll.

articles.title: « Le Brésil reste le dernier caillou d’importance dans la botte de Washington en Amérique latine, mais pour combien de temps ? »

articles.title: Cancer cases rising among young people, research finds
articles.description: New major research has found that cases of several different types of cancer have risen sharply among young people in England, the United States, and the Netherlands. Researchers are not exactly sure why there has been such an increase, but say it could be linked to a growing rate of obesity, poor diets and a lack of exercise.

articles.title: Colère des lycéens : plusieurs syndicats de l’Éducation appellent à une nouvelle journée de mobilisation jeudi

articles.title: Une enquête ouverte pour "tentative de meurtre" après l'interpellation d'un lycéen vendredi à Belfort, l'IGPN saisie

articles.title: À Sciences Po, le blocage «en solidarité avec le mouvement lycéen» dégénère

articles.title: Six recettes scandinaves salées ou sucrées à tester : gravlax de poisson sauvage, brioches à la cannelle...
articles.description: A la Ferme Le Pavillon, à Bargemon, dans le Haut-Var, les jeunes chefs danois Jonas Bisgaard Dahl et Nicoline Dragsdal mettent toujours la nature au menu. articles.title: Okinawa : les militaires américains soumis à un couvre-feu après le meurtre d’une femme pour lequel un marine est soupçonné
articles.description: Les crimes commis par des militaires américains constituent depuis longtemps une source de tensions dans les relations entre les deux proches alliés en matière de sécurité.
